dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 subprogram with INDEXED file I/O; Turkish-language messages suggest a student or academic project, possibly compiled with GnuCOBOL
evidence: Turkish strings: KAYIT BULUNDU, KAYIT EKLENDI

purpose.domain_detail: Student exercise implementing a generic CRUD subprogram for an indexed file, likely a banking or personal records context (name, surname, balance, date fields)
purpose.summary: PBSUB is a called subprogram that performs CRUD operations (read, write, delete, update) on an indexed VSAM-style file keyed by a numeric ID. It accepts a function code and ID via the LINKAGE SECTION and returns a result code and descriptive message. The update function also performs character substitution on the surname field.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with 88-level function codes for CRUD dispatch
INDEXED file with RANDOM access and file status checking
FUNCTION TRIM and STRING statement for log message construction
Character substitution via INSPECT REPLACING in update logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Author name 'YUNUS EMRE AKDIK' and Turkish messages strongly suggest a student project. The hardcoded name/date values in H320-WRITE (Yunus Emre, Akdik, 19980409) confirm this is a personal exercise rather than production code. Dialect is likely GnuCOBOL but could be any COBOL-85 compliant compiler.
